objects.description: [APT41 DUST](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0040) disguised [DUSTPAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1158) as a legitimate Windows binary such as `w3wp.exe` or `conn.exe`.(Citation: Google Cloud APT41 2024)
objects.description_fa: [APT41 DUST](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0040) [DUSTPAN](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1158) را به عنوان یک باینری قانونی Windows مانند «w3wp.exe» یا «conn.exe» پنهان کرد.(Citation: Google Cloud APT41 2024)
